summary.text: Tom Fernandez is a Republican state senator from Dorchester representing District 39, which covers parts of Berkeley, Dorchester and Orangeburg Counties. He is an attorney and serves on the Senate's Corrections and Penology, Education, Family and Veterans' Services, Judiciary and Medical Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: Fernandez was born on February 28, 1978, in Livonia, Michigan, according to his legislative biography.
He graduated from Coastal Carolina University with a B.A., received a J.D. from Charleston School of Law, and earned an M.B.A. from The Citadel.
He served in the S.C. State Guard, JAG Detachment, from 2018 to 2024 and has been a board member of Central Berkeley Fire & EMS since 2023.
His biography lists his home in Summerville.
